SHREC'17 HAND LANDMARK FILES
============================

Files covered
-------------

hands.txt
labels.txt

Provenance
----------

These files were obtained from the Geomstats hand dataset directory:

https://github.com/geomstats/geomstats/tree/main/geomstats/datasets/data/hands

The underlying dataset is described in:

Quentin De Smedt, Hazem Wannous, and Jean-Philippe Vandeborre,
"SHREC'17 Track: 3D Hand Gesture Recognition Using a Depth and Skeletal
Dataset," 2017. https://doi.org/10.2312/3dor.20171049

GeoJAX includes the two files only so its Kendall shape-space documentation can
be built and executed without a network download. Users of the data should
cite the source study and comply with any terms that apply to the original
dataset.
